bugs.root_cause: updateCommand filters/maps registry entries assuming entry.root is always a string (p.root.toLowerCase(), path.join(project.root, ...)); a malformed entry with a missing/renamed key crashes the entire fleet update before any project is processed.
bugs.fix: Rewrote readRegistry() in src/cli/registry.ts to filter malformed entries (missing/renamed root or name) at the single read point via isWellFormedEntry guard; warns to stderr with the drop count; the next writeRegistry from any caller (registerProject, update, stale-drop) persists the cleanup to disk. All downstream consumers (update.ts path.join / toLowerCase) are protected without per-call changes.

bugs.error_message: review nudge reports ~76 lines changed on a 1-line comment edit; small follow-up edits spawn fresh review rounds (Grok feedback: over-sensitivity)
bugs.root_cause: maybeNudgeReview computed approxLines from sessionEntry.totals.output_tokens_estimated, which is session-CUMULATIVE. Once cumulative output crossed min_diff_lines, every later stop with writes re-triggered the size gate and attributed all prior work to the new edit.
bugs.fix: Session-baseline delta: each review entry records covered_tokens = session output already under a review obligation; the size trigger uses (cumulative - max covered_tokens for this session)/17, so only genuinely new work counts. Also compressed the nudge with project-relative paths (986 -> 768 chars measured).

bugs.root_cause: Rubric vocabulary was taken from the external feedback text (3-tier, HIGH-top) instead of the actual companion runtime contract (4-tier, CRITICAL-top); first fix also edited only item 3 while claiming item 1 was fixed
bugs.fix: Rubric rewritten to four tiers (CRITICAL = distinct currently-reachable money/data/correctness path; HIGH = other reachable defect with material impact); item 1 now reads "does not mint a new CRITICAL/HIGH"; verified by GLM fix-verification + MiniMax final arbitration CLEAN on current bytes
